Cast copper alloy Wirral type, dating to the 2nd century AD. Intact apart from missing pin. Semi-circular head with plinth and head-loop above. Plinth is decorated with two rows of milling. Lug with median gap on rear of head suggests the brooch pin was operated by a hinge mechanism which was attached to the lugs by a transverse pin.
